descriptionHtml:
ضمان عام من الوكيل


**Rapoo XR100 Wireless Presenter**


**Brand:** Rapoo

**Model:** XR100

**Type:** Wireless Presenter / Remote Control

**Color:** Black


**Connectivity:**

Type: Wireless (2.4GHz)

Wireless Range: Up to 10 meters (33 feet)

Plug and Play: Yes (no driver required)


**Buttons & Controls:**

PowerPoint Controls:

- Next Slide (Page Down)

- Previous Slide (Page Up)

- Black Screen (B key)

- Full Screen (F5 key)


Pointer Controls:

- Red Laser Pointer


Other Controls:

- Start / Stop Slide Show

- Volume Up

- Volume Down


**Laser Pointer:**

Type: Class 2 Red Laser

Wavelength: 630-650nm

Output Power: <1mW

Visible Range: Up to 100 meters (328 feet)


**Power:**

Battery Type: 1 x AAA battery (not included)

Battery Life: Up to 12 months (based on 2 hours daily use)

Low Battery Indicator: Yes (LED flashes)


**Physical Specifications:**

Dimensions: 115 x 37 x 25 mm (4.5 x 1.5 x 1 inches)

Weight: 45 grams (with battery)

Form Factor: Pen-shaped / Ergonomic design


**Storage:**

USB Receiver Storage: Built-in compartment (receiver snaps into presenter)

USB Receiver Dimensions: Standard nano size


**System Compatibility:**

Operating Systems: Windows 7 / 8 / 10 / 11, macOS

Software Required: Microsoft PowerPoint (or compatible presentation software)

Other Software: Works with Keynote, Google Slides, LibreOffice


**Package Includes:**

Rapoo XR100 Wireless Presenter

2.4GHz USB Receiver (stored inside)

User manual


**Warranty:** 1 year (depending on region)


**Features:**

Plug and Play (no driver installation)

Red laser pointer

Built-in USB receiver storage

Energy-saving design

Compact and portable (pen size)


**Pros:**

Affordable price

Long wireless range (10m / 33ft)

Long battery life (12 months)

Compact design (fits in pocket)


**Ideal For:**

Business presentations

Classroom lectures

Conference speeches

Sales meetings

Webinars and training sessions
